O.content: The blue vertical inscription reads "0-14 years (%)".
The red vertical inscription reads "65 years + (%)".
A blue circular mark is higher on the page than a red square mark aligned with the 2014 tick.
No numeric y-axis tick labels are visibly printed.

B.text: If the blue 0-14 years series and red 65 years + series use vertically comparable percentage scales, then their vertical positions at the same year encode comparable population shares; the higher mark represents the larger share. Under the task instruction, the larger 2014 group maps to its corresponding planning follow-up record.
B.conditions: The colored axis inscriptions and matching mark colors bind blue circles to 0-14 years and red squares to 65 years +. The chart must use the same or demonstrably comparable vertical percentage scales; no numeric y-axis tick labels are visibly printed to verify that condition.
